title: A 1H-1,5-benzodiazepine derivative induces apoptosis in colorectal cancer cells by inhibiting JAK/STAT signaling pathway.
authors: Jin, Yan; Lahcen, Marouane Ait; Gong, Tong; Fang, Hong; Yue, Yuqi; Ma, Yunhao; Adardour, Mohamed; Cheng, Zeying; Xu, Ning; Baouid, Abdesselam; Chen, Peng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苯二氮卓衍生物T0通过抑制JAK/STAT信号通路诱导结直肠癌细胞凋亡，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is among the most common cancers worldwide, with limited pharmacological options currently. Benzodiazepine and its synthetic derivatives are now of interest as their bioactive attributes, especially their inhibitory effect on various cancer cell lines. Herein we designed and synthesized of a series of compounds, among which T0, a 1H-1,5-benzodiazepine derivative, which exhibited potential inhibitory activity against colorectal cell lines in vitro. Relative to 5-fluorouracil, compound T0 exhibited a superior cytotoxic effect while maintaining lower toxicity. Additionally, our research indicated that T0 decreased mitochondrial membrane potential and activated reactive oxygen species (ROS) production in CRC cells leading to mitochondria-mediated apoptosis. Mechanistically, T0 could downregulate the JAK/STAT signaling pathway which was in good agreement with docking result and the observed in vitro activity. Structural analysis through molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay (CESTA) revealed T0's high-affinity interaction with the protein JAK, suggesting T0 was a potential JAK inhibitor. Overall, this study suggested T0 may be a potential lead compound for the therapeutic option of human CRC.
abstract_zh: 结直肠癌（colorectal cancer, CRC）是全球最常见的癌症之一，目前可用的药物选择有限。苯二氮卓类及其合成衍生物因其生物活性特性，尤其是对多种癌细胞系的抑制作用，而受到关注。在此，我们设计并合成了一系列化合物，其中T0，一种1H-1,5-苯二氮卓衍生物，在体外对结直肠癌细胞系表现出潜在的抑制活性。与5-氟尿嘧啶相比，化合物T0展现出更优的细胞毒性效应，同时保持较低的毒性。此外，我们的研究表明，T0降低了CRC细胞中的线粒体膜电位，并激活了活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS）的产生，从而引发线粒体介导的凋亡。机制上，T0能够下调JAK/STAT信号通路，这与对接结果及观察到的体外活性高度一致。通过分子对接和细胞热位移分析（cellular thermal shift assay, CESTA）进行的结构分析揭示了T0与蛋白JAK的高亲和力相互作用，表明T0是一种潜在的JAK抑制剂。总体而言，本研究提示T0可能成为人类CRC治疗选择中的潜在先导化合物。
